discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
rationale: After AI/neural networks (2024) and macroscopic quantum tunnelling in circuits (2025), the committee is likely to return to condensed matter. Topological insulators are a mature, highly cited field that built on the 2016 topology prize. Kane and Mele predicted the Z2 quantum spin Hall state, and Molenkamp's group confirmed it experimentally in HgTe quantum wells. The theorist-plus-experiment pairing has already been recognized with the Breakthrough, Dirac and Oliver Buckley prizes.
